entries.subject: fix(material/slider): update inactive input width on value change (#28275)
entries.reason: The patch updates the inactive range-thumb width when the MDC slider input value is set. The package has no slider input and no range thumb. That width update was not added.

entries.subject: fix(material/slider): fix internal focus state on safari (#28243)
entries.reason: The patch clears the MDC slider focus on Safari and immediately shows the hover ripple again. The package has no slider input and no visual thumb. That Safari path was not added.

entries.subject: fix(material/slider): fix animation issue (#28704)
entries.reason: The patch turns the slider track transition off and updates the track when a thumb is focused, so a later arrow key does not animate from the other thumb. The package does not define MatSliderThumb. The focus call was not added.

entries.subject: fix(material/slider): thumb jumping on safari (#33619)
entries.reason: The diff in src/material/slider/slider-input.ts changes `this._updateThumbUIByValue({withAnimation: true});`. The commit is on the v22.2.0 research head and is not an ancestor of installed peer v22.1.7 (e950f29dcfbda93c13bff0d1a632465364488249). This package does not ship that file and does not treat the research head as the runtime baseline.
